source: A real fix in this repository (PR #1354, commit 137d2a57). prefix.patch is the pre-fix state of four ops scripts as new-file diffs; ground truth was written from the fix after blind reviews ran.

bugs.bug: worktree paths with spaces truncated by read/awk
bugs.example: clean_finished.sh: a worktree path containing a space is truncated by read -r wt br and awk $2, so the wrong path is judged and removed

bugs.bug: lsof missing -> in-use check fails open
bugs.example: clean_finished.sh: if lsof is not installed the in-use check returns empty and the worktree is removed anyway (fails open)
clean_finished.sh: two worktrees with the same basename write the same archive file, so the second overwrites the first patch
land_train.sh: a failed merge is swallowed by the pipe to tail and || true, so the script exits 0 despite the failure

bugs.bug: invalid banlist regex (grep rc>=2) treated as no match, fail-open
bugs.example: prefile_check.sh: an invalid banlist regex makes grep exit 2, which is treated as no match, so the privacy check fails open
pipe_mask_guard.py: the HIT regex misses pytest and jest, tee/sed/awk after the pipe, and |&, so masked failures pass the guard
